topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: V-band's robust performance at high altitudes, coupled with precise modulation techniques to mitigate interference, offers a compelling advantage. However, this requires careful design of antenna array architecture and link budget analysis. While optical systems hold promise in certain scenarios, V-band's inherent advantages in terms of bandwidth availability and atmospheric attenuation make it the preferred choice for most inter-satellite communication needs.
